Strategy: Pair items on a square-root scale. Prefer a bin whose leftover is near the item size, measuring closeness in square roots, so very loose bins are punished less harshly than tight ones are rewarded. Score by square-root distance from a leftover of one item, exact fits tied at the top, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to a bin near the pairing point. It may help by tolerating roomy bins, but may fail by letting loose bins win.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(abs(sqrt(r - item) - sqrt(item))) + (sqrt(item) if r - item == 0 else 0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Sqrt pairing distance: score by -abs(sqrt(leftover)-sqrt(item)), exact fits tied at top.
